description: Angular component for configuring a label card widget in the Thingsboard UI, including form setup, validation, and configuration handling.

classes.name: LabelCardBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for label card widget configuration, extending BasicWidgetConfigComponent.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for the widget configuration.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided widget configuration data.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and returns the widget configuration data based on form inputs.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns the list of form controls that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on current form state.

methods.name: getCardButtons
methods.description: Determines which card buttons should be enabled based on widget config.

methods.name: setCardButtons
methods.description: Sets the card buttons in the widget config based on selected buttons.
